name: done-then
description: Start a cancellable shutdown countdown when the current Codex turn stops.

interface.longDescription: Arm a session-bound, time-limited grant that starts a cancellable shutdown countdown when the current Codex turn stops. Stop is an observable lifecycle event, not a claim that the task succeeded. A separate experimental verified-success mode remains available for development.
defaultPrompt: Shut down this computer two minutes after this turn stops; I understand Stop may not mean the task succeeded.
Dry-run Done Then for this turn and report the observed Stop state.
Show the current Done Then job status without taking a power action.
